description: This file contains functions and type definitions related to evaluating and resolving system run allowlists, including handling of command arguments, security policies, and output truncation.

methods.name: evaluateSystemRunAllowlist
methods.description: Evaluates whether a given system command or shell command complies with an allowlist, returning analysis details including matches and satisfaction status.

methods.name: resolvePlannedAllowlistArgv
methods.description: Resolves the command-line arguments for a planned allowlist entry if certain security and policy conditions are met.

methods.name: resolveSystemRunExecArgv
methods.description: Determines the final argument vector to execute, considering allowlist policies and platform specifics.

methods.name: applyOutputTruncation
methods.description: Appends a truncation suffix to the output or error streams of a run result if it was truncated.
